title: Uploaded image deletion behavior decision
purpose: Document the two competing requests for what happens when a user selects Delete on an uploaded image, and keep both alternatives as unsatisfied candidates pending a human decision.

scope.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete. No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.

requirements.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

stories.text: If a human selects the immediate permanent deletion alternative, an image owner will see their uploaded image deleted immediately and permanently when they select Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion alternative, when the owner of an uploaded image selects Delete, then the image is deleted immediately.
Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion alternative, when the owner of an uploaded image selects Delete, then the image is not recoverable afterwards.

stories.text: If a human selects the 30-day recoverable deletion alternative, an image owner will see their uploaded image remain recoverable by them for 30 days after they select Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverable deletion alternative, when the owner of an uploaded image selects Delete, then the image remains recoverable by that owner for 30 days after Delete.
Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverable deletion alternative, when 30 days have elapsed since the owner selected Delete, then the image is no longer required to remain recoverable.

dependencies.text: No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet, so the deletion behavior cannot be finalized.

risks.text: Immediate permanent deletion would fail the support request for 30-day recoverability; 30-day recoverable deletion would fail the privacy request for immediate permanent deletion.

open_questions: Which alternative should a human select: immediate permanent deletion or 30-day recoverability by the owner?
Who has authority to choose between the privacy request and the support request?
